entries.desc: Renderer: builds the sorted light list and renders lights. Found from L"ScreenShadowMaskTexture".

entries.name: RenderLights light sort-key patch site
entries.desc: `mov esi, 0x40` (BE 40 00 00 00) that sets SE's sort-key bit 0x40. The community fix writes 0x60 to the immediate (byte at +1) so these lights also get bit 0x20. Fixes lights rendering wrong (green) at non-16:9 view aspect ratios, which includes every VR eye view.

entries.name: CalcSceneView windowed-fullscreen view rect
entries.desc: In ULocalPlayer::CalcSceneView (0x3018da0): `call [rax+0xF0]` (FViewport::GetWindowMode, returns the field at +0xC4), `cmp eax, 1` (windowed fullscreen), `jne +0x38` over code that replaces ViewRect and ConstrainedViewRect with (0, 0, GSystemResolution.ResX, ResY). That runs after GetProjectionData applied the stereo device's AdjustViewRect, so in windowed fullscreen both eyes would get the full rect. The mod turns the jne (0x75) into jmp (0xEB) while stereo renders.

entries.name: FSceneRenderTargets::Allocate size from GSystemResolution
entries.desc: movd xmm1,[GSystemResolution.ResX]; movd xmm0,[ResY] in Square Enix's FSceneRenderTargets::Allocate (0x2540c10). The scene buffer size is max(this frame, last frame) of GSystemResolution x r.ScreenPercentage / 100, rounded up to a multiple of 4; the view family size is not used (r.SceneRenderTargetResizeMethod is registered but never read). A stereo eye target larger than the window therefore needs GSystemResolution raised to the target size while stereo renders.

entries.name: RHI command list append sequence
entries.desc: How the engine appends a recorded RHI command (rdi = FRHICommandListBase, rcx = command): *CommandLink(+8) = cmd; ++NumCommands(+0x14); CommandLink = cmd; cmd->ExecuteAndDestruct(+8) = fn; cmd->Next(+0) = null. Many copies exist (for example in FFakeStereoRendering::RenderTexture_RenderThread at 0x3317b84); the lowest address is recorded here. Confirms the command list layout the mod relies on to append its own command.

entries.name: FDeferredShadingSceneRenderer::Render
entries.desc: The scene renderer's Render (render thread). After the scene and before post-processing it runs the in-game UI pass once per view (BeginRenderingInGameUI / UI render delegates / EndRenderingInGameUI), gated by the view family's in-game UI flag. STATIC.
entries.howto: The only function that calls both BeginRenderingInGameUI and FPostProcessing::Process; its vtable slot is the only data reference (0x4d56a10).

entries.name: GSceneRenderTargets
entries.desc: The FSceneRenderTargets object (static, not per view) passed as `this` to the in-game UI functions; +0x110 is the pooled InGameUIRenderTarget. STATIC.
entries.howto: lea rcx before the call to BeginRenderingInGameUI in the per-view UI loop of FDeferredShadingSceneRenderer::Render (views are 0x28B0 bytes, Views.Data at renderer +0xD0).

entries.name: FSceneRenderTargets::BeginRenderingInGameUI
entries.desc: bool (FSceneRenderTargets* this, FRHICommandListImmediate&, const FViewInfo& View) (name ours). Allocates the pooled target InGameUIRenderTarget when this+0x110 is null (FindFreeElement 0x253d6b0, PF_B8G8R8A8, flags TexCreate_SRGB, targetable, 1920x1080 / 3840x2160 when GSystemResolution.ResX > 1920 / r.InGameUI.FixedWidth x FixedHeight), binds its targetable texture with a clear and sets the viewport (0,0,W,H). Returns true. The view argument is not used by this function. STATIC; LIVE (hooked by the mod).
entries.howto: The only code reference to L"InGameUIRenderTarget".

entries.name: FSceneRenderTargets::InGameUIRenderTarget
entries.desc: TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> InGameUIRenderTarget in FSceneRenderTargets (lea r9,[rcx+110h] = FindFreeElement's out parameter). IPooledRenderTarget +8 TargetableTexture, +0x10 ShaderResourceTexture. Every InGameUITexture binding reads it as the global GSceneRenderTargets+0x110 (0x5923be0). STATIC.

entries.name: FSceneRenderTargets::InGameUISize
entries.desc: FIntPoint size of the in-game UI target in FSceneRenderTargets (+0x240 X, +0x244 Y), written by BeginRenderingInGameUI when it allocates. STATIC.

entries.name: FSceneRenderTargets::EndRenderingInGameUI
entries.desc: void (FSceneRenderTargets* this, FRHICommandListImmediate&) (name ours). Ends the UI pass: records a copy-to-resolve of the UI target (targetable -> shader resource; the same texture here). Called after the UI render delegates, once per view that ran the pass. STATIC; LIVE (hooked by the mod).

entries.name: FSceneViewFamily in-game UI flag
entries.desc: test byte [renderer+4Ch], 80h in FDeferredShadingSceneRenderer::Render: the renderer's ViewFamily copy starts at +0x10, so the flag is bit 0x80 of the byte at FSceneViewFamily+0x3C. When it is clear the UI pass is skipped, and every material shader's InGameUITexture binding (about 320 inlined sites `test byte ptr [r14+3Ch], 80h` with r14 = View.Family) binds the engine's fallback texture (FTexture* at 0x594c370, TextureRHI +0x30) instead of InGameUIRenderTarget->ShaderResourceTexture, so nothing is composited. STATIC; LIVE (clearing it after the UI pass removes the UI from the eye images).

entries.name: IRendererModule slot HasInGameUIDelegates (A)
entries.desc: Render's UI pass asks the Renderer module (GetRendererModule(), cached at 0x5831000) +0x150 / +0x170 whether UI render delegates are registered and calls +0x148 / +0x168 (View, RHICmdList, SceneContext) to draw them (names ours; the shape of UE 4.18's RenderPostOpaqueExtensions / RenderOverlayExtensions). The game's UMG UI is drawn through these delegates. STATIC.

entries.name: FPostProcessing::Process
entries.desc: Post-processing of one view, called per view at the end of FDeferredShadingSceneRenderer::Render after the UI pass (this = GPostProcessing at 0x582893e). The UI composite happens inside it. Name INFERRED (UE 4.18 call shape).

entries.name: Bloom reduce pass Process
entries.desc: Process() of Square Enix's bloom reduce pass (pooled targets 'BloomReduce', output size = scene buffer size >> (level + 1); vtable 0x4d5fd90 slot 5, ComputeOutputDesc 0x2286700). this+0xA8 = level, this+0xAC = first level. The first level reads the view's rect at FViewInfo+0x70 (C++ side and vertex constants carry the offset) but its pixel shader samples the input relative to the origin: for the right eye it reduces the left eye's image (the right-eye ghost). Levels and the 'BloomBlur' upsample chain (Process 0x2286a60) all sit at the origin; the tonemapper reads the result at the origin.
entries.howto: The chain builder 0x2287ba0 (called from FPostProcessing::Process when view+0xE70 > 0) allocates ten passes with this vtable and nine with 0x4d5fe18; slot 5 of the vtable is Process. The function checks +0x85 (level/first-level loads) and +0xD5 (`mov r10d,[r9+0x70]`).

entries.name: FRenderTargetPool::FindFreeElement
entries.desc: bool FindFreeElement(RHICmdList (rdx), const FPooledRenderTargetDesc& (r8), TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget>& Out (r9), const TCHAR* DebugName (5th argument), ...). RCX is not used. IPooledRenderTarget: +0x08 TargetableTexture, +0x10 ShaderResourceTexture; FRHITexture vtable slot 7 = GetNativeResource. Hooked by the GPU trace to name textures.
entries.howto: Called with L"CustomGlare" from FSceneRenderTargets::BeginRenderingCustomGlare (0x2544ed0) and with every other pooled target name (about 100 callers).

entries.name: FViewInfo size
entries.desc: sizeof(FViewInfo): the stride of the renderer's Views array (imul in the UI loop of FDeferredShadingSceneRenderer::Render). STATIC.
